D: Hello, I'm Dr Maes. You're Mrs Grace Okafor?
P: Yes. My son Emeka drove me from Ghent.
D: What has been happening?
P: I'm always thirsty. I drink four litres of water a day and I go to the toilet all night. My vision is blurry when I read.
D: Have you lost weight?
P: Five kilos since the summer, and I wasn't trying. I have a sore on my foot that won't heal either.
D: Can I see it?
P: Here, under the big toe. I can't feel it much. The nurse at AZ Sint-Lucas cleaned it last Tuesday.
D: Did anyone mention Addison's disease or thyroid problems?
P: No, only my sugar. They said it was very high.
D: Where do you live exactly?
P: Kortrijksesteenweg 230, Ghent. My number is 09 224 31 50, and I was born on 30 June 1956.
